mapicons.rule: sprite = <palette>_<jobIcon>_<weapon>; palette = persons.UnitIconID (E suffix = Engage form, NOT enemy); jobIcon = jobs.UnitIconID_M|_F by persons.Gender; weapon = jobs.UnitIconWeaponID or the unit's equipped weapon class. Named units carry their own palette and are not force-tinted; generic soldiers are force-tinted via palette (B=player, R=enemy, G=ally, Y=other, N=neutral).
